text_en: After this Paul left Athens and went to Corinth.
text_cn: 此后，保禄就离开雅典，来到了格林多。

text_en: There he found a Jew named Aquila, a native of Pontus, who had recently come from Italy with his wife Priscilla, because Claudius had ordered all Jews to leave Rome. Paul went to see them,
text_cn: 在那里遇见了一个犹太人，名叫阿桂拉，原籍本都，他同妻子普黎史拉最近从意大利来，因为喀劳狄曾命所有的犹太人都离开罗马。保禄就投到他们那里，

text_en: and, because he was of the same trade, he stayed with them, and they worked together—by trade they were tentmakers.
text_cn: 因为是同业，保禄便留在他们那里工作；原来他们是以制造帐幕为业的。

text_en: Every sabbath he would argue in the synagogue and would try to convince Jews and Greeks.
text_cn: 每逢安息日，保禄就在会堂里辩论，劝化犹太人和希腊人。

text_en: When Silas and Timothy arrived from Macedonia, Paul was occupied with proclaiming the word, testifying to the Jews that the Messiah was Jesus.
text_cn: 及至息拉和弟茂德从马其顿来到后，保禄就专心传道，向犹太人证明耶稣就是默西亚。

text_en: When they opposed and reviled him, in protest he shook the dust from his clothes and said to them, “Your blood be on your own heads! I am innocent. From now on I will go to the Gentiles. ”
text_cn: 可是，因为他们反对，而且说亵渎的话，保禄就拂拭衣服向他们说：“你们的血归到你们头上，与我无干，从今以后，我要到外邦人那里去了。”

text_en: Then he left the synagogue and went to the house of a man named Titius Justus, a worshiper of God; his house was next door to the synagogue.
text_cn: 于是离开那里，进了一个名叫弟铎犹斯托的家里，这人敬畏天主，他的家紧靠着会堂。

text_en: Crispus, the official of the synagogue, became a believer in the Lord, together with all his household; and many of the Corinthians who heard Paul became believers and were baptized.
text_cn: 会堂长克黎斯颇和他的全家都信了主，还有许多格林多人听了道而相信，也领了洗。

text_en: One night the Lord said to Paul in a vision, “Do not be afraid, but speak and do not be silent;
text_cn: 夜间，主藉异象对保禄说：“不要害怕，只管讲，不要缄默，

text_en: for I am with you, and no one will lay a hand on you to harm you, for there are many in this city who are my people. ”
text_cn: 因为有我与你同在，必没有人向你下手加害你，因为在这城里有许多百姓是属于我的。”

text_en: He stayed there a year and six months, teaching the word of God among them.
text_cn: 于是，他就在那里住了一年零六个月，在他们中讲授天主的圣道。

text_en: But when Gallio was proconsul of Achaia, the Jews made a united attack on Paul and brought him before the tribunal.
text_cn: 当加里雍作阿哈雅总督时，犹太人同心合意地起来攻击保禄，把他带到法庭

text_en: They said, “This man is persuading people to worship God in ways that are contrary to the law. ”
text_cn: 说：“这个人劝人违法敬拜天主。”

text_en: Just as Paul was about to speak, Gallio said to the Jews, “If it were a matter of crime or serious villainy, I would be justified in accepting the complaint of you Jews;
text_cn: 保禄刚要开口，加里雍就向犹太人说：“犹太人啊！如果有什么犯法或邪恶的罪行，我自当容忍你们；

text_en: but since it is a matter of questions about words and names and your own law, see to it yourselves; I do not wish to be a judge of these matters. ”
text_cn: 但问题既是关于道理、名目和你们自己的法律的事，你们自己管罢，我不愿作这些事的判官。”

text_en: And he dismissed them from the tribunal.
text_cn: 就把他们逐出了法庭。

text_en: Then all of them seized Sosthenes, the official of the synagogue, and beat him in front of the tribunal. But Gallio paid no attention to any of these things.
text_cn: 于是众希腊人拉住会堂长索斯特乃，在法庭前打了他；而加里雍全不理睬这些事。

text_en: After staying there for a considerable time, Paul said farewell to the believers and sailed for Syria, accompanied by Priscilla and Aquila. At Cenchreae he had his hair cut, for he was under a vow.
text_cn: 保禄又住了些日子，就与弟兄们辞别，乘船往叙利亚去；和他一起的，有普黎史拉和阿桂拉，因为保禄许有誓愿，在耕格勒剃了头发。

text_en: When they reached Ephesus, he left them there, but first he himself went into the synagogue and had a discussion with the Jews.
text_cn: 到了厄弗所，保禄便把他们留在那里，自己进了会堂，同犹太人辩论。

text_en: When they asked him to stay longer, he declined;
text_cn: 众人求他多住些时候，他没有应允，

text_en: but on taking leave of them, he said, “I will return to you, if God wills. ” Then he set sail from Ephesus.
text_cn: 却辞别他们说：“若是天主愿意，我还要回到你们这里来。”遂从厄弗所开船走了。

text_en: When he had landed at Caesarea, he went up to Jerusalem and greeted the church, and then went down to Antioch.
text_cn: 在凯撒勒雅下船，就上耶路撒冷问候教会，然后下到安提约基雅。

text_en: After spending some time there he departed and went from place to place through the region of Galatia and Phrygia, strengthening all the disciples.
text_cn: 保禄住了一个时期，又出发，挨次经过迦拉达地区和夫黎基雅，坚固众位门徒。

text_en: Now there came to Ephesus a Jew named Apollos, a native of Alexandria. He was an eloquent man, well-versed in the scriptures.
text_cn: 有一个在亚历山大里亚出生的犹太人，名叫阿颇罗，是个有口才的人，长于圣经，他到了厄弗所。

text_en: He had been instructed in the Way of the Lord; and he spoke with burning enthusiasm and taught accurately the things concerning Jesus, though he knew only the baptism of John.
text_cn: 这人学过主的道理，讲论耶稣的事，心神热烈，教训人也很详实，却只知若翰的洗礼。

text_en: He began to speak boldly in the synagogue; but when Priscilla and Aquila heard him, they took him aside and explained the Way of God to him more accurately.
text_cn: 这人开始在会堂里放胆讲论。普黎史拉和阿桂拉听了他的讲论，就把他接来，给他更详实地讲解了天主的道理。

text_en: And when he wished to cross over to Achaia, the believers encouraged him and wrote to the disciples to welcome him. On his arrival he greatly helped those who through grace had become believers,
text_cn: 阿颇罗有意往阿哈雅去，弟兄们都鼓励他，并且给门徒写信，叫他们接待他；他到了那里，依赖恩宠，给了信友们很多的贡献，

text_en: for he powerfully refuted the Jews in public, showing by the scriptures that the Messiah is Jesus.
text_cn: 因为他经常有力地当众驳倒犹太人，用圣经指明耶稣就是默西亚。
